meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 为已经放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音:淡入淡出、轨道音量与自动化包络、人声挖孔(voiceover carve)、EQ/压缩/限幅等效果链,以及用 <hf-audio-group> 一条总线同时管多条轨道。不负责找音频或生成音频。
howto.when: 当合成里的音频已经放好、需要混音时触发:例如让音乐不压住解说时做挖孔、给轨道加效果链、或写音量自动化包络。找 BGM、做旁白属于 /media-use,剪辑时序属于 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给解说下面的配乐做一次 voiceover carve,让人声更清楚
say.note: 在配乐元素上写 data-fx-carve,不动人声轨

say.text: 给这条音轨加 highpass 80Hz 和压缩,再把轨道音量降 3dB
帮我画一条音量自动化包络,人声出现时把配乐压下去
say.note: 在轨道上写 data-automation 包络

howto.what_en: Mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, track gain and volume automation, voiceover carve, ducking, effect chains (EQ, compressor, limiter, etc.), and one <hf-audio-group> submix bus for several tracks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing: voiceover carve, effect chains, volume automation. Not for sourcing or generating audio.

say_en.text: Carve the music bed under my voiceover so the narration is easier to follow
say_en.note: Writes data-fx-carve on the bed, not the voice

say_en.text: Add a highpass at 80 Hz and a compressor to this track
Draw a volume automation lane so the bed dips while the voice talks
